newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26): no change to PM-SYM in 2025-2026 and no merger. The Maandhan portal (snapshot) says 'Revamping of Maandhan portal is under process' and still lists 18-40 years, income up to Rs 15,000, and a Rs 3,000 pension.

findings.note: The content gives '₹55 to ₹200' a month. The source table supports it (18 years ₹55 ... 40 years ₹200), but there is no fact entry quoting it, contrary to 'every amount has a quoted fact'. The amount is correct, so this does not block.
findings.suggestion: Add a fact quoting the contribution table, e.g. 'The contribution amount varies based on the age at the time of enrolment.' plus the ₹55 and ₹200 cells, or quote the portal.

findings.note: The 'unorganised sector employment' criterion (criterion 3) has no rule. It is covered indirectly by the EPF/ESIC/NPS exclusion and the income limit, so the outcome is right in most cases.
findings.suggestion: Accept. Optionally mention in the summary that salaried workers with EPF/ESIC are excluded (already implied).

findings.note: 'If the worker dies after age 60, the spouse can get half of the pension.' The source's key-features section says 50% family pension on the beneficiary's death without an age limit, and the exit section covers death before 60 separately. The text is consistent with the 'Death After 60 Years' fact.
